Christine Jensen is Assistant Professor of Saxophone and Contemporary Media at the prestigious Eastman School of Music. She is an active performer and composer, and regularly collaborates with her sister, Ingrid Jensen.
Christine was interviewed via Zoom on March 4, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
